0.0: Work, work, and more work... Oh! #b#p2040015##k sent you to take a picture of me? Sure, take a good one of me working hard. Now you can go see #bRoly-Poly 4#k on #b#m221022200##k.

npc.0: Oh, hello! #b#p2040015##k sent you, right? Now you can go meet #bRoly-Poly 4#k on #b#m221022200##k.

item.0: Oops, you lost the photo of the previous Roly-Poly? Well, then you just have to go back to Roly-Poly 3 and take another photo. Now I've got to get back to work!

quest.0: Hello! As you can see, I help repair Eos Tower! Oh, #b#p2040015##k sent you here? Hmm, then I think you should visit Roly-Poly 3 on #b#m221022500##k first.

lost.0: Oh no... Did you lose the picture you took with me? We'll have to take another one, then. Please make sure not to lose the picture this time around. Alright, here's a million-dollar pose of me working hard.
